result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional. One minor visual defect: the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation lacks an icon, unlike the other tabs, creating an inconsistent and seemingly broken navigation bar.

issues.description: The 'Orders' item in the bottom navigation bar shows only a text label with no icon above it, while 'Home', 'Search', and 'Profile' each have icons. This makes the navigation bar look visually broken/inconsistent and leaves an awkward empty gap above the 'Orders' label.
issues.suggestion: Add an appropriate icon (e.g., a receipt or bag icon) above the 'Orders' label to match the other navigation items and maintain visual consistency.
